summary: Small sealed bush car park beside a picnic area, no homes nearby.
reasons: No buildings mapped or visible nearby
Sealed bays with a way in

best_section.where: Northern, upper end of the car park, near the entry from the road

drivers.seclusion: Wooded on all sides; nearest structures are a picnic shelter and a small building about 40 m south-east in the park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed bays join the adjacent road at the north end. Pad is roughly 15 by 30 m, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Spur road beside it; busier road to the west carries freeway-style traffic.
drivers.convention: Mapped free asphalt car park with painted bays; no vehicles seen in the pad itself.

flags: Steep over the whole outline: about 7.5% mean, falls to the south
Road noise from the adjacent main road
Picnic area nearby may bring daytime visitors
sun_shade: Dense tree cover over most of the pad, especially the east and north sides.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is locked at night
